title: Integrating Surface Coating and Quasi-Solid Deep Eutectic Electrolytes for Enhanced Cycling of Micro-Si Anodes in Li-ion Batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript

Natthawut Suebsing, Pauline Jaumaux, Javad Safaei, Cherdsak Bootjomchai, Asif Mahmood, U. Tipparach, Guoxiu Wang
Micro silicon (μ-Si) anodes offer high capacity for lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), however, their application is severely limited by surface pulverization and poor interfacial contact. Here, we report an integrated approach...
